name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight Go server that exposes HTTP endpoints which run configured shell commands, with request data and trigger rules defined in a hooks file.

alerts.message: Hooks are defined in the hooks.json config file. The sample hook at /hooks/hello only runs when the X-Webhook-Token header matches the generated WEBHOOK_TOKEN environment variable. Commands run inside a minimal Alpine container as an unprivileged user, so edit hooks.json to add your own hooks and redeploy.
